Alex Chen: FYI HarborLend just uploaded their SIG/CAIQ PDF and asked for answers by EOD Friday. Link: https://drive.google.com/harborlend/sig-caiq.pdf
Tina Morales: Thanks — added to security queue. Quick clarifying Q: do they want a signed attestation or just questionnaire responses first?
Alex Chen: They asked for the completed CAIQ + any supporting evidence (network diagram, SOC2 report). I uploaded the minimal network diagram and our SOC2 link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/soc2.pdf
Samir Patel: I can own the technical CAIQ responses (sections 3–7). Need the infra diagram in editable form and any customer-specific encryption requirements. @Alex can you drop the VPC diagram .drawio?
Alex Chen: Done — added "harbor_vpc.drawio" to the drive folder. Also FYI customer is asking about dedicated/private deployment pricing for the POC (they want private instance for data separation).
Raj Kapoor: For a short POC we can propose 2 weeks of dedicated capacity (up to 4xA10G) — ballpark pricing I'll confirm with pricing, but estimate ~ $8k-$12k for the POC. I'll ping pricing now.
Tina Morales: Internal intake created. Two initial security flags I see: 1) Encryption at rest: they want CMK control in their KMS; we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM but need the KMS addendum signed. 2) Log export: they require syslog TLS with mutual auth — ops needs to confirm supported connectors.
Samir Patel: Noted. For the KMS addendum I can draft a short explanation of supported lifecycle and rotation policy. For syslog mTLS, @Raj can we get an ops runbook or confirm connector options?
Raj Kapoor: Looping in Ops in the funding thread. Ops said: we can support syslog over TLS but mutual TLS will need a small infra change; timeline ~3 business days.
Alex Chen: Customer deadline is Friday COB. If we can't fully finalize mTLS by then, can we provide a mitigated answer + timeline?
Tina Morales: Yes — we'll provide completed CAIQ with a callout: "mTLS for syslog is planned; workaround: TLS with client cert verification via proxy until dedicated connector is ready; ETA 72 hours after POC start." Marking as conditional.
Samir Patel: I'll draft the CAIQ answers and attach evidence. Plan: produce first draft by tomorrow noon, final by Thursday EOD.
forms-bot: New intake created: https://redwood.internal/intake/IN-4592 — owner Samir Patel — due 2024-06-28
Alex Chen: Thanks team. I'll update HarborLend with the timeline and attach the drive folder. Anyone else to add to the thread? @Legal for the KMS addendum redline and @Pricing for final POC number.
Tina Morales: Adding a short checklist for tracking: \n- Owner: Samir Patel\n- Evidence: SOC2, VPC diagram, KMS addendum (draft)\n- Gaps: mTLS for syslog, KMS addendum sign-off\n- POC ask: dedicated/private pricing (Raj to confirm)
Samir Patel: ACK. Will post the CAIQ draft link here when ready.
Raj Kapoor: I messaged pricing — will post final quote in this thread when they reply.
Tina Morales: Closing note: set priority = high; escalate if we don't have legal KMS sign-off within 48 hours. :alarm_clock:
Alex Chen: Great — I'll push this to the customer and keep you posted.
